caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a man in profile view, facing left. The man has curled hair styled back from his forehead, and his features include a pronounced nose and prominent chin. The bust is elaborately clothed in a richly decorated garment featuring patterns in shades of blue, red, brown, and beige. The garment has what appear to be large decorative buttons or ornaments on the front, and the intricate design includes areas with floral or leafy motifs. One hand is partly visible resting on his hip or side. The bust rests on a rectangular wooden base that is also rendered in brown tones. The background is plain and light, with no additional objects or elements present. The entire drawing is rendered with a realistic approach, using detailed shading and varied colors to suggest the material and texture of the sculpture and its attire.
title: Figurehead
